> Serious reading of mathematics is best done sitting bolt upright in a hard
> chair at a desk.  Pencil and paper are nearly indispensable; for there are
> always figures to be sketched and steps in the argument to be verified by
> calculation. [@savage1972foundations] (preface to first edition)
